fact: The ANSD's December 2024 BADIS 2019-2023 compiles more than 2,000 time series from survey data and administrative sources, with health, education, justice and transport series sourced to the ministries and the prison administration.
title: Banque de données des indicateurs sociaux - Edition 2019-2023
publisher: Agence nationale de la Statistique et de la Démographie (ANSD)
